'''Oggo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] leader of the [[Starbolts]] crime syndicate based on [[Asylum]]. Oggo and his rival [[Tanno Vik]] of the [[Blast Crew]] syndicate disagreed over the control of the [[Free Zone]] black market, settling their dispute with blasters. In [[3631 BBY]] Oggo was unexpectedly killed by [[HK-55]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], allowing Vik to takeover the Free Zone, though his reign was short-lived, as Asylum was attacked by the [[Eternal Fleet]] shortly afterwards.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oggo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 6: Asylum''' and is voiced by [[Erik Todd Dellums]].
